verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is a natural-language agent. The docs show users debugging with natural language, querying and editing large codebases, automating tasks like PR queries and rebases, issuing prompts such as '@github List my open pull requests', and mentioning @gemini-cli in issues and PRs. Hands-on reports confirm it navigates large codebases from plain requests, though other users report agentic loops and failed edits that undercut how reliably those commands are carried out. Missing for 10: consistent reliability in executing natural-language requests (several hands-on reports of loops and failed file edits), and in-depth first-party documentation of the interaction model beyond feature bullets.
